Samira K.: I missed open enrollment and now my toddler started daycare this month. Can I enroll in a Dependent Care FSA mid-year?
Erin (People Ops): Potentially yes if this qualifies as a QLE (start of dependent care). We need proof (enrollment confirmation, invoice, provider letter). Try to submit within 30 days of the change.
Samira K.: what file formats are fine? pdf or a photo?
Jordan (Benefits): PDFs, PNG/JPG are fine. Please upload via the benefits portal > Submit Life Event so it attaches to your record. A screenshot of the invoice with provider name and start date is OK.
Samira K.: submitted "milo-daycare-start.pdf" via portal. marked date as 2026-07-05.
people-bot: Life event submitted by Samira K. (Dependent care start). Ticket #BEN-4983.
Erin (People Ops): Received. I'll review and tag @Jordan for benefits confirmation. If approved, @Alex will coordinate payroll for deductions.
Alex (Payroll): Quick note: we usually start pre-tax deductions the next payroll after approval. If you need retro deductions to cover pay periods since the daycare start, we can process a one-time payroll adjustment within 60 days of approval. Retro changes can affect YTD taxable wages; we'll send details if you request it.
Samira K.: do I need my kid's SSN to enroll?
Jordan (Benefits): SSN is requested but not strictly required to set up the election. We do need DOB and provider info. If SSN arrives later, upload it and we'll update records for year-end filing.
Erin (People Ops): Also FYI, if you enrolled in dependent care and later stop using the provider, report it as another life event. Questions?
Samira K.: that's all for now, thanks!
people-bot: Life event BEN-4983 moved to "Under Review" by Erin (People Ops).
